'''Thaval''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], a conflict fought between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Voss]], providing training to [[Sith Inquisitor]]s.<ref name="The Old Republic" />
